title: Special Projects (2016)
summary: OpenAI's 2016 Special Projects post highlighting their early research initiatives and experimental projects during their foundational year, showcasing the organization's initial research directions before their more public breakthroughs.
problem_solved: Showcases OpenAI's early experimental research directions and attracts talent to work on cutting-edge AI projects.
why_valuable: Provides historical context on OpenAI's early strategic priorities and offers insight into their initial approach to AI safety and capabilities research.
